title: Demand Service Rate Programs: Writing a Reviewed Open Balance Ceiling on a Rate Program
content:
## When a ceiling is written

The open balance ceiling standing on a rate program held under the Demand Service Rate Programs is the
figure above which further work on the account waits for an office release. Where that ceiling falls due
for review, a reviewed ceiling is written onto the live program in its place.

## What changes on the program

Exactly one term of the live program changes: the ceiling above which further work on the account waits
for an office release is replaced by the figure given, the program is stamped as having had its credit
ceiling changed, and the day of the change is recorded. From that moment the account's headroom is
measured against the new ceiling and the owner sees the new ceiling on the program.

## Writing it

The desk handles this itself. The tool `set_program_credit_ceiling_aca954d3` is unlocked and then called
by the agent, with the ceiling to stand on the program worked out from the published terms and the
records and passed in; the tool writes the term and neither works the figure out nor judges whether the
terms allow it.

## The parameters

- `program_id` — the reference number of the demand service rate program whose ceiling is being written,
  read from the rate program lookup on the account.
- `credit_limit_usd` — the open balance ceiling to stand on the program, in USD to 2 decimal places,
  rounded half up at the cent and never negative.

## The receipt

One line of plain text comes back naming the rate program reference, the ceiling now standing on it in
USD to 2 decimal places and the day the change took effect. A line naming the new ceiling is the receipt
that the program term was changed.
